findings.finding: Male-data generation mechanism break begins at serial 683 / woman A168; laboratory-batch cause is unconfirmed.
findings.evidence: Rows 1-682 all satisfy the empirical unique-read identity within 2 reads; rows 683-1082 none do. A168-A267 each have exactly four rows. Y>=4% changes from 540/682 to 397/400.
findings.action: Use pre-683 as the recommended primary cohort and retain post-683 as a mandatory separate sensitivity cohort; do not claim a confirmed laboratory batch without external metadata.

findings.finding: Rows are nested repeated measurements, not independent observations.
findings.evidence: 267 women, 1021 operational draw events, 1063 assay sessions and 1082 rows; 40 draw events contain multiple detections covering 101 rows, while 19 same-day sessions cover 38 rows.
findings.action: Retain all four hierarchical IDs; never use row-independence for inference or splitting, and do not treat H as a blood-draw timestamp.

findings.finding: Unique mapped reads exceed raw reads in a subset.
findings.location_rule: O > L; all affected rows have 序号 >= 683
findings.evidence: Logical contradiction under the supplied column definitions.
findings.action: Mark; exclude from analyses that use sequencing-count covariates. Already outside the recommended primary cohort.

findings.finding: Date-derived gestational age is not interchangeable with column J.
findings.evidence: 404 exact matches; 12 unusable LMP values; 22 negative deltas.
findings.action: Use J as primary gestational age. Date flags are diagnostic only.

findings.finding: Clinical support is strongly concentrated in high BMI and irregularly sampled weeks.
findings.evidence: 262/267 women; only 5 below 28 and none below 20.
findings.action: Keep, but restrict interpretation to observed support and report sparse cells.

findings.finding: Sequencing failures are not directly identifiable in the male sheet.
findings.location_rule: No explicit failure flag and no row with missing L-AA sequencing metrics.
findings.evidence: All 1082 rows contain the sequencing numeric block. Repeated assays may reflect retesting, but no failed attempt is labelled.
findings.action: Do not estimate a failure rate or delete a row as failed solely from retesting/GC. Treat complete observed records as potentially selected successful outputs.

findings.finding: Reported gestational ages are parseable but extend beyond the stated 10-25 week window.
findings.evidence: 8 women affected; no record is below 10 weeks.
findings.action: Exclude from the approved [10,26) primary window; retain for sensitivity.

findings.finding: Global GC is technically below 40% in many rows, mostly just below the boundary.
findings.evidence: Only 2 rows are below 39%; the remainder lie in [39%,40%).
findings.action: Mark only; do not label all as failed or delete without a validated assay rule.

findings.finding: Baseline-like fields are not perfectly constant within woman.
findings.evidence: Age varies in 12 women, height in 5, LMP in 5; IVF is constant.
findings.action: Mark and predefine baseline/first-record or time-varying treatment by field.

findings.finding: Date storage types change at serial 687 / A169.
findings.evidence: H changes from integer YYYYMMDD to date objects; F changes from date objects to strings.
findings.action: Normalize types and retain; do not treat storage format as biology.

findings.finding: BMI is arithmetically consistent with height and weight.
findings.action: Retain K as supplied; no BMI imputation or correction required in the male sheet.

modelability_without_fitting.warning: Nominal row count is not the independent sample size; inference must respect woman/draw nesting and the 683 batch split.

hard_exclude.rule: Missing/invalid B, J, K or V; V outside (0,1); BMI<=0.

exclude_from_recommended_primary_keep_fo.rule: 序号>=683 or J outside 10w0d-25w6d; retain in separate sensitivity cohorts.

mark_only.rule: Repeated assays, unusable LMP/date inconsistency, GC boundary, sequencing-count flags, Tukey outliers and V<4% are retained with explicit flags.
